name: Centella asiatica extract
description: Centella asiatica extract (CAS 84696-21-9 ), also known commercially as Gotu Kola extract, is a standardized botanical extract derived from the whole herb of Centella asiatica. It is used across personal care, pharmaceutical, and nutraceutical formulations. The extract is primarily utilized for its wound-healing support, skin-firming, and antioxidant properties. In cosmetic formulations, it is incorporated into anti-aging creams, serums, and scar-treatment products for skin repair. Its triterpenoid content, including asiaticoside, madecassoside, and asiatic acid, supports collagen synthesis and skin barrier repair. Pharmaceutical manufacturers use it in topical wound-healing preparations and oral dosage forms. These pharmaceutical applications often target microcirculation and connective tissue support. In nutraceuticals and dietary supplements, it is formulated into capsules and tablets marketed for cognitive function and vascular health. Food-grade versions are used in functional beverages and wellness products in select Asian markets. Centella asiatica extract is supplied as a dry powder or water-soluble extract with various standardization levels. Standardization typically ranges from 10% to 80% total triterpenoids, including asiaticoside, madecassic acid, and asiatic acid. Cosmetic and pharmaceutical grades are available to meet specific industry needs. Suppliers offer specifications aligned to USP and Ph.Eur. monograph requirements where applicable.
